per_fold_training_scope: Each leave-stream-out fit has nine timed checkpoints, all actual node S and declared task role S->G; 36 normal candidate rows.
limitations: First eligible decision in each time band selected only the S loaded round in all twelve actual checkpoints. It does not represent all node/task roles.
Deployment source nodes are recovered from the first edge of already validated selected full witnesses, cross-checked against every candidate; raw snapshot tray node is used for collected labels.
The nominal bag OD role differs from actual current node for next_edge intermediate-node replanning; both counts are retained.
Labels use an artificial cancellation/reversal/jitter Monte Carlo future law. The 32 deployments use the four fixed nominal tapes, a different descriptive realization.
Label regret and deployment cost are not estimates of one common population expectation. Degradation is not identified as caused only by out-of-range inputs.

Other plausible contributors include sparse/role-biased sampling, route-continuation mismatch, synthetic future-law mismatch, optimization instability and misspecification; this run does not isolate causal shares.
Negative results do not establish that the V3 learning objective should be abandoned. They diagnose this declared limited experiment.

Next development should first collect reachable B/C and other encountered node/OD roles or one round of recovery only on each fold's training streams. Keep held-out streams isolated and retain all fixed seeds; choosing seeds or adding epochs is not a role-coverage repair.
